Description
Antigen–Antibodyconfidence: high
This structure is an antibody fragment (Fab-like VL/VH pair) bound to Lysozyme C, a glycosyl hydrolase 22 family enzyme with bacteriolytic activity. The VL and VH chains form the antigen-binding module, while chain C corresponds to the lysozyme antigen recognized by the antibody. The complex illustrates molecular recognition of a bacterial cell-wall-degrading enzyme by an antibody, with no indication of a biologically relevant small-molecule ligand in the provided summary.
ReasoningThe structure contains two antibody variable-domain chains, annotated as VL (chain A) and VH (chain B), forming an antibody fragment. Chain C is a separate protein antigen, identified by UniProt annotation as Lysozyme C, and the contact data show direct VL/VH interface with the antigen. Therefore the complex is best classified as antigen-antibody rather than a generic protein-protein complex.
